title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Anika Rao
release_notes: Adds autotune defaults for batching/caching, introduces quantization profile presets, and exposes unit-economics dashboarding for cost simulations.
description: Motivation: reduce per-token serving cost out-of-the-box by providing sane autotuned defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, plus curated quantization profiles and tooling to estimate unit economics. This PR wires together three workstreams: 1) runtime defaults and heuristics for autopilot batching/caching, 2) quantization profile library and selection heuristics, 3) unit-econ tooling in the console and CLI to simulate cost impact.
commits: feat(runtime): introduce AutotuneConfig and default heuristics for batching and kv-caching
feat(quant): add quant-profiles v1 (int8, q4_0, q4_1 presets) + selection logic
feat(tooling): unit-econ CLI subcommand + console UI hooks
chore(tests): add integration tests for batching/caching under mixed request size
fix(ci): adjust test timeout flakes in perf-canary suite
review_comments: Mateo Chen (2025-02-12): This looks good overall. A few nits: the batching window default (50ms) could hurt tail latency for short requests. Can we make it adaptive by recent p95?

Anika Rao (2025-02-12): Reply: Good point - changed the heuristic to sample p50/p95 and scale window in autotune.py (see commit 'feat(runtime): introduce AutotuneConfig...'). Added a comment and unit test.
Priya Kapoor (2025-02-13): The quant-profiles file is a great start. Are we validating accuracy regressions anywhere? I don't see evaluation hooks in the pipeline.

Anika Rao (2025-02-13): Reply: Added a lightweight eval in tests that runs a small prompt-set against model variants and validates token-level divergence < threshold. We don't gate rollout on this yet - added a TODO and Linear ENG-1401.
Liam O'Neill (2025-02-14): Unit econ UI looks promising. For the CLI, can we accept custom cloud pricing inputs?
Anika Rao (2025-02-14): Reply: CLI accepts a --price-file JSON with region pricing; updated README and added example in quickstarts.
Mateo Chen (2025-02-15): CI failed on first run due to flaky perf-canary test; reran and all checks passed. Approving now.
Priya Kapoor (2025-02-16): Approve after minor doc fixes.
changelog:
- Autotune defaults for batching and KV caching
- Quantization profiles (int8, q4_0, q4_1) and model selection heuristics
- Unit-economics CLI and console integrations for cost simulations
- Integration tests and docs
notes_for_reviewer: Focus on autotune heuristic correctness (adaptive window), quant-profile safety checks, and unit-econ inputs. Perf tests are in redwood/tests/test_autotune_integration.py.
